title: The Effect of PRP Augmentation of Arthroscopic Repairs of Shoulder Rotator Cuff Tears on Postoperative Clinical Scores and Retear Rates: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: A risk-of-bias assessment was made for all randomized clinical trials included, using the Cochrane collaboration’s tool as well as a quality assessment for all non-randomized studies utilizing the Newcastle–Ottawa scale.
adjudication.k_quote: Out of the 25 trials assessed, 16 were randomized controlled clinical trials.
adjudication.reason: Randomised and non-randomised trials pooled together with no RCT-only synthesis reported.
